text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I stepped into the library,
King Halo called out to me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Do you remember our discussion about the trial enrollment?
I was appointed as a guide, you see. And so...
I've come to need a partner to assist me.
choice_data_list: A partner... Have you decided on someone?
A partner... Do you know who it'll be?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Someone who sparked my intuition.
Someone who always wants to be of help to others,
earnest, and sincere.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Indeed—Kitasan Black!
I intend to go speak with her right now.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phew, all done with that one!
Is there anything else I can help with?
Don't hold back, please let me know!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, Sensei!
Are you carrying those boxes? Let me help you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kitasan Black enthusiastically helped one person after another.
Curious, we watched her for a while, but—

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Just when does that girl ever rest!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even outside the academy grounds,
Kitasan Black continued assisting people without taking a single moment to catch her breath.
choice_data_list: She looks so full of life, though...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Even so!
She hasn't had a single second to breathe.
Kita-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
...Ah, King-san!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Were you worried that I might be tired?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm completely fine, really!
Today is my day off from training, after all.
It's what you'd call a rest day!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...Do you even understand what a rest day means?
You've been working non-stop this entire time!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I-Is that so?
I was just helping people out...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
...It seems you truly don't comprehend.
Very well. Come with me, Kita-san!
I shall teach you what a true, first-class rest day looks like!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll take that one as well!
—Ah, this piece. Does it come in any other colors?
Come now, Kita-san. Try this on yourself!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes!
Whoa... what lovely clothes.
Ehehe, I wonder if it looks good on me...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
King herself shall provide you with first-class backing vocals.
Now, sing your heart out!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
All right~! 
Kitasan Black, taking the stage!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
How does that look? A table lined with sweets!
Once you've feasted your eyes, savor every single bite with your tongue!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Wah, wah, they look just like jewels!
Gosh, thanks for the treat~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After that, King Halo brought Kitasan Black to various places—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Phaa~... That was so much fun!
It's been ages since I played like this.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: How do you feel? Doesn't the tension feel lifted from your shoulders?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
My shoulders... huh? Come to think of it...
Why? I didn't think I was feeling strained at all...
choice_data_list: You were helping people all day, right?
You spent all day helping others, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
B-But helping others is just... second nature to me.
If anything, it feels fulfilling.
choice_data_list: Is it the same fulfillment you're feeling right now?
You need to take care of yourself, too.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...When you put it that way,
it does feel different, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Helping others is an admirable deed.
However, it carries a degree of responsibility with it.

text_block_list.name: キタサンブラック
text_block_list.text: 自分のことも……ですか？

text_block_list.name: キングヘイロー
text_block_list.text:
人助けは立派なことよ。
でも、そこには少なからず責任が生じるの。

text_block_list.name: キングヘイロー
text_block_list.text:
任されたからには……手を貸したからには、
やり遂げる。あなたはとても誠実だし、
多少なりとも気を張るでしょう？

text_block_list.name: キングヘイロー
text_block_list.text:
休み方は、それぞれだから、
強制はしないけど……人助けをしたら、
自分にもご褒美をあげなさい。

text_block_list.name: キングヘイロー
text_block_list.text:
でないと、助けられる方だって
申し訳なくなってしまうわ。

text_block_list.name: キタサンブラック
text_block_list.text:
キングさん……。
……そっか、そうですよね。

text_block_list.name: キタサンブラック
text_block_list.text:
……。えへへ、ありがとうございます。
あたし、すごく大事なこと……
教えてもらった気がします！

text_block_list.name: キタサンブラック
text_block_list.text:
何かお礼がしたいですっ。
あたしにお手伝いできること、
ありませんか！？

text_block_list.name: キングヘイロー
text_block_list.text:
ふふっ、ちょうどよかった。
あなたに頼みたいことがあったの！

text_block_list.name: モノローグ
text_block_list.text:
満足そうなキングヘイロー。
どうやら、案内役の相棒は
キタサンブラックで決まったようだ。
